categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Brandmax Marketing Co., Ltd. primarily operates in marketing services and digital retail. Its main business segments include interactive displays, retail terminal management, brand communication, and digital retail business. The company provides comprehensive marketing services such as planning, execution, monitoring, and feedback, integrating new technologies to enhance consumer brand experience and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including AI, generative AI, large language models, VR/AR, and naked-eye 3D to drive digital and intelligent transformation in marketing services. It develops AI-powered marketing tools, intelligent data processing systems, and digital retail operation platforms. The company also applies AI for quality inspection, customer interaction, and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) brands, consumer electronics companies, pharmaceutical companies, and automotive brands. Major clients include Nestlé, FrieslandCampina, Mars, Huawei, and others. The company serves industries such as consumer electronics, pharmaceuticals, fast-moving consumer goods, wholesale and retail, and automotive sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with extensive coverage across major regions including East China, South China, North China, Northeast China, Central China, Southwest China, and Northwest China. It has a nationwide execution network covering over 300 prefecture-level cities and 1,400 county-level cities. There is no significant overseas revenue reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Brandmax operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the marketing and retail supply chain. It acts as a service provider facilitating brand marketing, retail terminal management, and digital retail sales, connecting brands with end consumers through both online and offline channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on technology-driven innovation, emphasizing the integration of AI, VR/AR, and immersive technologies into marketing services. Strategic priorities include digital and intelligent transformation of marketing services, expansion of brand IP portfolios through organic growth and acquisitions, and internationalization of marketing services. R&D initiatives target AI-enhanced marketing tools, intelligent data systems, and digital retail platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through marketing service contracts, digital retail sales, and brand communication services. The company earns income from project bidding, brand online sales (both B2B and B2C), e-commerce platform operations, and customized marketing solutions. It also receives government subsidies and investment income from financial products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading technology-driven integrated marketing service provider in China with strong brand recognition and a broad client base. It competes in a fragmented marketing services industry with many players but differentiates itself through advanced technology application, extensive execution network, and strong client relationships with top-tier brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.29 billion, representing a 1.58% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 14.04 million, with a decline compared to the previous year due to increased competition and operational adjustments. The company maintains strong cash reserves of RMB 848 million to support growth and strategic initiatives.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong Brandmax emphasizes its unique value proposition of combining cutting-edge technology with creative marketing solutions to deliver immersive consumer experiences. Its competitive differentiation lies in its AI-driven marketing tools, nationwide execution capabilities, rich IP and media resources, and ability to integrate online and offline marketing channels to enhance brand value and sales performance.
